subject.title: [Bug]: publishable plugin runtime builds cannot emit native CJS entrypoints

question: Should `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` be accepted as the package-build knob for publishing msteams with native `.cjs` runtime sidecars?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix adds package build metadata and changes official installed-plugin startup artifacts, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive maintainer territory.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 is reviewed, repair its type-check blocker, and land it if the CJS package contract is accepted.

options.title: Reject the CJS build surface
options.body: Close or revise the linked PR if maintainers decide publishable plugin runtime packages should stay ESM-only for now.

options.title: Choose another packaging design
options.body: Keep this issue open but replace `runtimeFormat` with the preferred internal packaging mechanism before publishing msteams artifacts.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 is reviewed, repair its type-check blocker, and land it if the CJS package contract is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the package-local plugin runtime build helper this issue targets.
